about.title: About NisaDrive
about.subtitle: Empowering women through safe, dignified mobility
about.story.part1: NisaDrive was born from a deeply personal challenge—one that countless women in Pakistan silently endure every day: the simple act of commuting. Our story began with
about.story.part2: , a bright and determined AI student, who missed classes and opportunities just because her school van broke down or was unavailable.
about.story.part3: That frustration turned into inspiration. Guided by her dream to remove barriers to women's mobility, she envisioned NisaDrive—a ride-hailing platform designed by women, for women.
about.story.part4: What started as an idea has grown into a nationwide movement, nurtured under the umbrella of the
about.story.part5: —a forward-looking organization committed to "AI for All" and social innovation.
about.mission.title: Our Mission
about.mission.description: Empowering women through safe, dignified, and reliable transportation across Pakistan
about.values.title: Our Core
about.values.description: NisaDrive is culture-aligned, tech-enabled, and women-led, offering a safe, dignified, and reliable transport alternative for millions of Pakistani women.
about.journey.title: Our
about.journey.description: From Rawalpindi to remote areas, our roadmap aims to empower 10,000+ women over the next five years—whether as riders, drivers, coders, or community builders.
about.founder.title: A Word from
about.founder.quote: "At NisaDrive, we're not just giving women a ride—we're giving them freedom, safety, and opportunity. Whether you're a student, a single mother, or a dreamer like I once was, know that this platform belongs to you. Let's drive forward—together."
about.vision.title: Our
about.vision.description: Beyond Pakistan, we envision NisaDrive reaching other underserved regions where women face similar cultural and mobility barriers. Backed by robust legal compliance, data privacy protection, and a Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL) framework, NisaDrive is more than a platform—it's a promise to build a safe, inclusive, and accountable future for women in the digital economy.

impact.problem.description: In Pakistan, 70%+ of women report facing mobility challenges due to harassment, high cost, or lack of female-friendly transport (UN Women & World Bank, 2022). faq.page.questions.whatIsNisaDrive.answe: NisaDrive is a women-centric ride-hailing service designed to provide safe, affordable, and culturally appropriate transportation for women in Pakistan. The platform empowers women both as passengers and as driver-partners (affiliates).
faq.page.questions.whoCanBecomeDriver.qu: Who can become a NisaDrive driver/affiliate?
faq.page.questions.whoCanBecomeDriver.an: Any woman who meets the minimum age and licensing requirements and has access to a bike or can purchase one (with or without NisaDrive's support) may register as an affiliate driver.
faq.page.questions.availableCities.quest: Is NisaDrive available in my city?
faq.page.questions.availableCities.answe: NisaDrive is launching pilot operations in Rawalpindi. Expansion to other cities will follow based on demand and feasibility assessments.
faq.page.questions.howEnsureSafety.quest: How does NisaDrive ensure rider safety?
faq.page.questions.howEnsureSafety.answe: All drivers undergo background verification, safety and customer care training. The app includes emergency SOS, geo-fencing, real-time tracking, and 24/7 support.
faq.page.questions.workingHours.question: What are NisaDrive's working hours?
faq.page.questions.workingHours.answer: Our working hours include 07 am-07 pm daily, however affiliates manage their own schedules; nevertheless, the app and customer support operate 24/7 to ensure availability and safety.
faq.page.questions.howFareCalculated.que: How is fare calculated on NisaDrive?
faq.page.questions.howFareCalculated.ans: Fare is calculated based on standard per-kilometer rates. Rates are designed to be affordable for users while offering sustainable income for affiliates.
faq.page.questions.cancelRideRefund.ques: What if I want to cancel a ride or request a refund?
faq.page.questions.cancelRideRefund.answ: Please refer to our Refund & Cancellation Policy, available in the Legal section of the app or website.
faq.page.questions.howProtectData.questi: How does NisaDrive protect my personal data?
faq.page.questions.howProtectData.answer: NisaDrive complies with PECA 2016 and proposed Data Protection Bill guidelines to protect personal information, supported by our Privacy and Data Sharing Policies.
faq.page.questions.canMenUse.question: Can men use NisaDrive?
faq.page.questions.canMenUse.answer: No, NisaDrive is exclusively designed for women passengers and women drivers to maintain cultural and personal comfort.
faq.page.questions.howJoinInternship.que: How can I join the NisaDrive Internship Program?
faq.page.questions.howJoinInternship.ans: You can sign up for early access to internships by visiting the Careers section of our website and subscribing to updates.
